raw_text: Lloyd's List can confirm that multiple commercial vessels transiting the Strait of Malacca and Andaman Sea have experienced GPS navigation anomalies consistent with coordinated spoofing. Shipping operators report position errors of up to 50 nautical miles, creating significant safety hazards in one of the world's busiest shipping lanes. The International Maritime Organization has been notified. Vessel operators are advised to rely on radar and visual navigation as backup until the GPS integrity is restored.
clean_text: Lloyd's List confirms GPS spoofing affecting Strait of Malacca and Andaman Sea shipping. Position errors up to 50nm. IMO notified. Operators advised to use radar and visual navigation backup.
